system.description: Unlike the Lasombra or Ventrue, Brujah rarely bother Embracing mortals of noble lineage, instead encouraging humans to seize change for their own sake. Even so, some Brujah possess a force of personality that could make the most confident of monarchs show deference. A character with this Merit suffers -2 difficulty on all rolls involving Presence.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots
